name: toast
title: Toast
description: Brief messages about what just happened, with one optional action; call toast() anywhere under the provider.

when: Confirming an action that finished: saved, sent, deleted (with Undo).

instead.when: The message must stay until resolved.

guidance.rule: Write in the past tense: "Order confirmed".

builtIn: Announced politely; danger toasts stay until dismissed.
The provider mounts the toast region once.
